entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Second stage of the first Phyrexian Invasion in which the plane of Rath was overlaid on Dominaria.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Artificial plane engineered by Phyrexia as a staging ground; ceased to exist after the Overlay.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian leader whose strategy was to fuse worlds.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Heart of Rath that landed in Urborg.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Swamp island where the Stronghold landed.

entities.name: flowstone
entities.description: Malleable substance used to expand Rath.

events.summary: Rath is overlaid on Dominaria, delivering Phyrexia's legions onto Dominarian soil and devastating regions.
events.quote: Jagged spires of flowstone overwrote entire regions of Dominaria

events.summary: Crovax kills Tsabo Tavoc in the Stronghold's throne room, solidifying his rule.
The Stronghold lands in Urborg, Koilos falls, and the Coalition fights the invaders.
events.quote: The immediate consequence was the fall of Koilos

events.summary: Rath ceases to exist, its substance embedded in Dominaria.
events.quote: Rath, as a plane, ceased to exist after the Overlay.

relations.quote: The artificial plane of Rath, long engineered and cultivated by Phyrexia
